newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL - AVG YIELD ON PORTUGAL 3-YR BONDS SEEN RISING.
newsitem.headline: POLL - AVG YIELD ON PORTUGAL 3-YR BONDS SEEN RISING.

text.p: Following is a summary of four banks and one brokerage's forecasts for the Institute for Public Credit Management's auction of 25 billion escudos ($132.5 million) of March 2000 bonds on Tuesday.
The bonds closed at 5.31 percent on the secondary market on Monday for a spread of eight basis points with the Spanish Bono.
Auction results are due around 1000 GMT.
Three of the five analysts expected all 25 billion escudos to be placed compared with the 6.475 billion placed on July 14.
Analysts said the slightly higher yields compared with the secondary market reflected the continuing impact of the dollar's recent rise against the mark, which sparked concerns of a German rate rise.
Though analysts expected good demand for the paper, they were uncertain about how much the Institute would agree to place.
"I do not believe the Institute will want a spread wider than 10 basis points with Spain," an analyst said.
